technology_name: A TEMPLATE-FREE METHOD FOR SYNTHESIZING BIOCOMPATIBLE NANOPOROUS MICROSTRUCTURES
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Conventional synthesis of nanoporous microstructures relies heavily on toxic organic surfactants, hazardous chemical templates, or energy-intensive extraction loops.
description: A green Surfactant-Free and Template-Free synthesis pathway that utilizes green coffee leaf extract coupled with specific amino acids to induce self-polymerization into highly stable biocompatible nanoporous frameworks.
applications: Antimicrobial surface coatings, targeted drug delivery capsules, biomedical scaffolding matrices, and advanced bio-sensing diagnostic arrays.
secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, MedTech & Health Care
